ours_NCI_ALMANAC.split: whole-drug-pair held-out (no pair in both train and test)

comparability_verdict: NOT directly comparable: different datasets (NCI-ALMANAC vs O'Neil/DrugComb) AND different split strictness. Row-level CV lets the same drug pair appear in train and test via other cell lines; our pair-held-out split measures novel-pair generalization. To our knowledge no published NCI-ALMANAC pair-held-out number exists; ours is the first reference point for this split on this dataset. No world-best claim made.
